name: Guitar Tuner
author: icung
description: Live guitar tuner in the bar: listens to the mic, detects the played string, and shows how many cents off you are.

barWidget.description: Plucks are detected from the microphone and matched to the nearest string. Green = in tune, yellow = close, red = off. Right-click for settings.

schema.label: Tuning preset
schema.description: String tuning for matching. Half-step = Eb tuning, open-g = D G D G B D.

schema.label: Reference pitch (A4)
schema.description: Concert pitch in Hz. 442 for orchestras, 432 for some vintage setups.

schema.label: In-tune threshold
schema.description: Cents within which a string counts as perfectly in tune (green).

schema.label: Mic sensitivity
schema.description: Higher = detects quieter plucks but may pick up background hum.

schema.label: Capo fret
schema.description: Shift all string targets up by this many semitones (as if a capo sat on that fret).

schema.label: Auto-listen on panel open
schema.description: Start listening automatically when the settings panel opens.

schema.label: Auto-stop after silence
schema.description: Stop listening after a period without a pluck. Saves battery and closes the mic.

schema.label: Auto-stop delay
schema.description: Seconds of silence before auto-stop kicks in.

schema.label: Display mode
schema.description: Icon only keeps the bar compact; icon-text also shows the note and cents.
